input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives each Party a ninety (90) days' notice exit against a one-year auto-renewing term, which satisfies the fallback on our notice period and, for HDI, operates as end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days' notice (the renewal mechanic itself is a RENEWAL, not a T4C, issue). The fallback fails on one material term: Section 4.2(a) charges us an uncapped Termination Payment (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000, halved) whenever we terminate, which can vastly exceed three months of fees and is a penalty on our convenience exit. We have added a proviso capping the Termination Payment at three months of the fees payable under Section 3.1; the "if any" and instalment mechanics in 4.2(b)-(c) continue to operate against the capped amount. We have not pressed the preferred 30-day/pro-rata-refund position, which would require reworking the whole Section 4 bargain.

proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.1 already lets us exit on ninety days' notice, but the Section 4.2(a) Termination Payment is an uncapped penalty tied to Net Sales, so we have capped it at three months of the fees payable under Section 3.1, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed three (3) months of the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1.
